name: content-engine
description: Content engine for B2B marketers: a keyword or a published URL in, a researched, fact-checked article in your voice out. Small skills chained into two pipelines, every step saved to a file so you can fix the one that went wrong. Built on Ryan Law's (Ahrefs) content engineering approach, upgraded with CXL course tactics. Start with /content-engine:setup in your personal OS folder.
